description: Rows of one dataset, filtered, with the district, school, county, and demographic names joined in. `filters` takes code columns and category columns (describe_dataset's `filters` lists the exact keys and valid values). Use `year` or `year_min`/`year_max`, not both. `detail` picks what one row describes (default: the dataset's finest level). Returns `rows` and a `columns` list (type, role, unit, what a NULL means, and `is_key_metric` on the headline column); `key_metric` repeats the headline column's name. A NULL usually means the source suppressed the value, not zero. `columns` returns only the listed columns, `include_labels=false` leaves out the names, and `order_by` with `order` sorts on the server, so a top-N needs only N rows. Pages are small (default 100, at most 500); when `truncated` is true, `bulk_export` gives the REST API address that returns the whole result as CSV or Parquet. A bad filter returns an error listing the valid keys and values.

columns.description: Return only these columns (dataset columns and joined name columns). Omit for all.
columns.title: Columns

detail.description: Level of detail, i.e. what one row describes: 'schools', 'districts', 'counties', 'tracts', 'states', ... (each dataset lists its own). Omit for the dataset's default.
detail.title: Detail

filters.description: Column -> value (or list of values). Keys are the code columns (district_code, school_code, county_fips, tract_geoid, demographic), the dataset's category columns, and a few lookup-table attributes (demographic_category, district_type, school_level, locale); describe_dataset's `filters` lists the exact keys and valid values. A list is OR; several keys AND together. A wrong key or value returns an error listing the valid ones.
filters.title: Filters

include_labels.description: Join the district, school, county, and demographic names (default true); false returns codes only.
include_labels.title: Include Labels

main_topic.description: Subject area: 'education' (the default), 'census', or 'immigration'. A dataset's key starts with it.
main_topic.title: Main Topic

offset.description: Number of rows to skip, for paging.
offset.title: Offset

order_by.description: Sort by one column (a dataset column or a joined name column). Default order is the row's identifying columns. NULL (suppressed) values sort last either way.
order_by.title: Order By

topic.description: Dataset name, e.g. 'act_scores' (the last part of a key from list_datasets or search_datasets). The full key, e.g. 'education/gosa/act_scores', also works and sets main_topic.
topic.title: Topic

year.description: Exact year. Use this or year_min/year_max, not both.
year.title: Year

name: query_dataset
title: Query a Dataset
